raw_text: Iranian security forces have pre-emptively detained at least 200 activists ahead of the Mahsa Amini anniversary. Reports of protests in Tehran's Enghelab Square despite heavy crackdown. Diaspora solidarity marches planned in 50+ cities worldwide. Mobile internet shut down in Kurdistan province. The regime fears another uprising.
